source_title: Whoopi Goldberg Honors Late Friend Patrick Stewart with Touching ‘Star Trek’ Tribute - People.com
source_excerpt:
The actress shared a heartfelt message for her longtime friend and former costar, whom she reunited with on Star Trek: Picard decades after their original series
Whoopi Goldberg honored her late Star Trek: The Next Generation costar Patrick Stewart in an Instagram tribute on Friday, Oct. 30
The actress shared a photo of their characters’ figurines alongside the message, “See you on the next holodeck”
Goldberg and Stewart developed a friendship while working together on Star Trek and later reunited on Star Trek: Picard
Whoopi Goldberg is saying goodbye to her longtime friend and Star Trek costar Patrick Stewart .
On Friday, Oct. 30, Goldberg, 70, honored the late actor with an Instagram post featuring figurines of their beloved Star Trek characters standing side by side.
“See you on the next holodeck,” the actress wrote in the caption, adding, “RIP.”
Goldberg appeared alongside Stewart on Star Trek: The Next Generation from 1988 to 1993, portraying Guinan, the Enterprise-D’s bartender and trusted confidante. Stewart starred as Capt. Jean-Luc Picard, the starship’s commanding officer.
The pair developed a lasting friendship while working on the series and reunited several times over the years, including during appearances on The View . During a memorable 2020 appearance on the daytime talk show, Stewart surprised Goldberg by personally inviting her to reprise her role as Guinan in season 2 of Star Trek: Picard .
Goldberg beamed as the audience erupted in applause before getting up to hug Stewart and enthusiastically accepting his invitation with a “Yes!”
“ Star Trek was one of the great experiences from the beginning to the end,” Goldberg said. “I had the best, best, best time ever.” To which Stewart replied, “Well, wonderful having you, and we cannot wait to have you with us again.”
Goldberg went on to appear in scenes across season 2 of Picard .
The pair also co-starred in the 1994 animated and live-action film The Pagemaster , starring Macaulay Culkin .
Stewart’s death was announced on Thursday, Oct. 29, by his longtime spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak, who confirmed that the actor died at 86 following “a brief and poignant journey” with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.
“He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” the statement continued. “We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.”
“He explored the human condition in all its poetic complexity and brought hope not only to the far reaches of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but into science fiction’s most iconic final frontier aboard the Starship Enterprise,” the statement added.

Fellow Star Trek alum William Shatner , 95 — who appeared alongside Stewart in 1994’s Star Trek Generations — paid tribute to the late actor.
“Sir Patrick Stewart was a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor,” he began. “From the stage to the bridge of the Enterprise, he brought intelligence, grace, and a deep sense of humanity to everything he did. Captain Picard stood for the best of us, and so did the man who played him. I was filled with affection and admiration for him and his work.”
“My heart goes out to Sunny and his family. He will be deeply missed,” he concluded.
Rebecca Romijn , who starred in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds and the X-Men franchise alongside Stewart, shared a tribute on Instagram .
“I feel so grateful to have known him for the last 25 years and to have been in his orbit for that last 25 years, both as a fellow mutant and as a fellow member of Starfleet,” she began. “He was positively delicious, hilarious, naughty, incredible sense of humor.”
The actress remembered “that booming voice of his, that always spoke to the very back of the room, as every classically trained Shakespearean great needs to master,” adding Stewart “has always been an inspiration.”
Romijn concluded, “I want to send my condolences to his family. I’ll miss my friend dearly. Rest in peace, Patrick.”
